subject.description: single Physarum slime mould as a flat gold filament lattice, dense and muscular, pushing thick tapering veins outward to absorb small square icon tiles

micro_detail_requirements: varied rounded holes of unequal size
physical_details.finish: flat vector fills, no gradients on the background, no cast shadows

environment.location: flat bead-black canvas #080c0c with faint hairline grid seams #293232
background: three labeled tile groups around the organism: sdlc (left, 3 tiles), design (right-top, 2 tiles), cli (right-bottom, 4 tiles)
aqua #8ce6dc bracket and tiny lowercase mono label above each group
thin aqua divider between the design group and the cli group
environment.atmosphere: quiet technical instrument datasheet, precise and editorial

camera_technical.framing: straight-on orthographic, organism centered at about 45 percent of frame height
camera_technical.composition: left column of 3 tiles, right side split into a top row of 2 and a bottom row of 4, balanced margins

realism_anchors: tiles nearest the organism are half engulfed by gold lattice and tinted gold
middle tiles are touched by a single vein
outermost tiles stay dark and untouched
tiles are #192121 with 1px #5b6665 border and 6px radius
tile labels are small monospace uppercase in cream #f6f3eb
negative_prompt: colors outside gold, aqua, cream and bead-black
glow or halo around the organism
